slides.0.title: Industry and market
slides.0.subtitle: Scale, the three-tier system, direct shipping and sustainability
slides.1.title: Industry scale (with years)
slides.1.highlights.0.title: Oregon (2022)
slides.1.highlights.0.content: 1,116 wineries (612 crushing grapes) and 44,487 acres; only 7,100 acres in 1995
slides.1.highlights.1.title: Washington (2017)
slides.1.highlights.2.title: New York (2019)
slides.1.highlights.2.content: About 470 wineries; most grape acreage is still labrusca such as Concord
slides.1.content: Always quote numbers with a year; national rankings differ between sources, so do not memorise them.
slides.2.title: The three-tier system and direct shipping
slides.2.highlights.0.title: Three tiers
slides.2.highlights.0.content: Producer, wholesaler and retailer kept separate, the common state framework after Prohibition
slides.2.highlights.1.title: Granholm v. Heald (2005)
slides.2.highlights.1.content: On 16 May 2005 the Supreme Court held that states may not let in-state wineries ship directly while burdening out-of-state ones; the three-tier system itself remains legitimate
slides.2.highlights.2.title: Why it matters
slides.2.highlights.2.content: It matters most to small wineries, which can sell directly to out-of-state consumers
slides.2.content: The ruling banned discrimination, not the three-tier system.
slides.3.title: Sustainability certification
slides.3.highlights.0.title: Sustainable WA
slides.3.highlights.0.content: Washington's first statewide certified sustainability programme for winegrapes, launched in 2022 by four industry bodies
slides.3.highlights.1.title: Salmon-Safe dual certification
slides.3.highlights.1.content: Announced 11 April 2024; wineries may use the Sustainable WA logo with 75% certified fruit and the Salmon-Safe logo with 95%
slides.3.highlights.2.title: Coverage
slides.3.highlights.2.content: Nearly one-third of Washington's vineyard acreage is in the programme
slides.3.content: Sustainability certification has moved from a bonus to part of market communication.
